Players Committee card image of [[Ponda Baba (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Game text of non-Jedi Luke (or a lightsaber he is using) may not target aliens here. During battle, if with a smuggler, may add a destiny to attrition (+2 if with your smuggler) or make that smuggler forfeit = 0.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/pondababa.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
